lead: Reaching the Sun is surprisingly hard: you have to cancel Earth's sideways speed, not just fly towards it.
try: Press Play the seven years to watch the Parker Solar Probe get closer and closer.
points: Earth races around the Sun at about 30 km every second. To fall towards the Sun, a spacecraft must lose most of that speed.
Parker used Venus's gravity seven times to slow down and fall closer.
At its closest, Parker is the fastest object people have ever made.
